Done — the footer is now a single line. On the first screenshot: that was a stale view; the "Patchwork Labs | Single Feather" row was already removed in commit `981822a` (which is pushed), so production already matches your second screenshot.

What I changed in `src/components/FOOTER.tsx`:

- Merged the webring row and the copyright/social row into one wrapping flex row, separated by a `|` divider: `← IndieWeb Webring 🕸💍 → | ©2026 Jasper Mayone… | [icons]`. Desktop footer is now 32px tall (was two stacked rows).
- Sized the webring arrows and emoji down (`text-sm`/`text-xs` with `leading-none`) so they sit flush with the rest of the line instead of rendering at base 16px.
- On narrow screens the row wraps into centered stacked lines, and the `|` dividers are hidden below the `sm` breakpoint so they don't dangle at line ends.

Verified in a local dev server at 1200px (one clean line) and 375px (wraps to three centered lines without orphaned pipes), and lint plus `tsc --noEmit` pass. I stopped the dev server afterward and left the change uncommitted for you to review.

One unrelated thing I noticed at 375px: the floating theme-toggle bubble overlaps the copyright text — that's page layout, not the footer, but worth a look if you care about mobile.
